summary: CR-482 P11 (F2), P12 (F8), P14 (F4), P15 (F9) frontend testing on preview URL against preprod (owner@cafe103.com). Login OK. Place Order / Print Bill clicks were blocked by a window-level capture click interceptor, so no orders were placed, nothing was printed and no bills were settled. No POST requests other than login/station-order-list were sent to preprod. Each handler works on its own: F2 focuses the search box and selects its text, and does nothing while the customization modal is open. F8 clicks Place Order from the search box, a grid item or a cart row. It does nothing when the cart is empty (button disabled), when focus is in the customer-name input, or when a modal is open. F4 clicks order-entry-print-bill-btn-1537752 on C1 and refocuses search; on an empty table it does nothing. F9 opens the Collect Payment panel on a new order with items. On C1 it does nothing because collect-bill-btn is disabled (order status Ready, not Served, so isServed is false). While the payment panel is open, F2/F8/F4/F9/arrows are all inert. With the flag OFF, the hook is not attached and mouse clicks work (add item, Place Order, Collect Bill, payment back). Regression P4 Enter, P8 +/-, P10 Ctrl+Down/Esc and P9 Shift+Tab/Down/Enter pass. ONE REAL BUG: F8 conflicts with the Radix Toast viewport hotkey (default ['F8']). After every F8 press, focus moves to the toast viewport <ol>, so the next F4/F9/F8/Enter/arrows/+/- do nothing until the user presses F2 or clicks.

ui_bugs.issue: Radix @radix-ui/react-toast ToastViewport has VIEWPORT_DEFAULT_HOTKEY=['F8'] and a document keydown listener that focuses the toast viewport <ol>. It ignores defaultPrevented. After F8, document.activeElement becomes OL. Seen in logs: F9 -> prevented True (search); F4 -> True (search); F8 -> True (search); next F9 -> prevented False with active=OL; F2 -> brings focus back. The shortcut flow breaks after F8: a cashier pressing F8 then F9/F4, or scanning the next item, gets no response. This also happens with shortcuts OFF (pre-existing Radix behaviour), but it now collides directly with P12.

ArrowRight from the first item 'test1' jumped to 'party lunch' (index 8, first item of row 2) instead of 'Bean Snapshot Salad' (index 1). The scoring dist = |dx| + 2*|dy| lets a slightly-right item in the next row (dy about 58px) beat a wide pill in the same row (dx about 150px). Other moves were correct (Right 8->9, Down 9->19, Left 19->18, Up 18->8). This code was not changed by P11-P15, so it is pre-existing and not a regression.

action_items: Fix the F8 / Radix toast conflict. Option A: in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/toaster.jsx use <ToastViewport hotkey={[]} /> (or a non-conflicting hotkey such as ['altKey','KeyN']). Option B: in OrderEntry P12 F8 branch call e.stopPropagation() after preventDefault (the hook listens on window capture, Radix on document, so this stops Radix). Option A is more robust because it also covers F8 when shortcuts are OFF and on other screens. Then re-verify that F8 -> F9 and F8 -> F4 sequences keep focus in search.
Optional: improve moveFocus so ArrowLeft/Right prefer items in the same row (e.g. require |dy| < half the row height, or weight dy much more heavily) before wrapping to the next row.
critical_code_review_comments: useKeyboardShortcuts.js clickIfEnabled: `el.style.display !== 'fixed'` is meaningless because display is never 'fixed'; this was probably meant to be getComputedStyle(el).position === 'fixed'. position:fixed buttons have offsetParent === null and will always be treated as hidden. This does not affect the current buttons but is a latent bug.

P14 F4: setTimeout(() => searchInputRef.focus(), 300) runs even when clickIfEnabled returned false. When there is no print button, F4 pressed on a cart row moves focus to search. Minor; consider refocusing only when the click happened.

kbdEnabled = settings.keyboardShortcuts || localStorage flag. Setting the localStorage flag to 'false' does not turn shortcuts off if the server/profile setting is on. During testing the server setting was off, so OFF testing was valid.
F8/F4/F9 share the same 'allowed' active-element check (written out three times). Extract it into a helper (DRY).
OrderEntry.jsx is over 3000 lines and should be split into modules.

Observation (pre-existing): while the Collect Payment panel is open, the menu grid can still be clicked with the mouse. A stray click added 'Butter Scotch Ice Cream' to the cart mid-payment and the panel total updated. Consider disabling the grid while the payment panel is open.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (24/26 checks pass; F8 focus-steal bug and pre-existing P3 diagonal wrap)

seed_data_creation: None. Only unplaced cart lines were added to C2 in the browser (never sent to the server). C1 order #021102 was read only; one Print Bill click on it was intercepted and blocked.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login owner@cafe103.com / Qplazm@10 works. Set localStorage mygenie_keyboard_shortcuts_enabled before login. Table cards: C1 = table-card-8321 (click the 'Owner' text inside the card to open OE; order #021102, status Ready so collect-bill-btn is disabled; print button order-entry-print-bill-btn-1537752). C2 = table-card-8322 (available). For safe testing, register window.addEventListener('click', ..., true) that calls stopImmediatePropagation for place-order-btn and print-bill buttons, and log keydown on document capture with activeElement to detect the toast-viewport focus steal (activeElement tag OL). Payment panel testid: collect-payment-panel, close with payment-back-btn. kbdEnabled can be detected with [data-testid=kbd-focus-trap-end].
rca of the issue: F8 focus steal: @radix-ui/react-toast ToastViewport (rendered by components/ui/toaster.jsx, mounted in App.js L298) registers document.addEventListener('keydown') with hotkey ['F8'] (node_modules/@radix-ui/react-toast/dist/index.mjs L62/L84) and calls viewportRef.focus() without checking event.defaultPrevented. The CR-482 hook runs on window capture and only calls preventDefault, so the event still reaches Radix. Repro: open any table with shortcuts ON, focus search, press F8, then F9: activeElement is <ol> and F9 is ignored. Mitigation: hotkey={[]} on ToastViewport, or e.stopPropagation() in the F8 branch.
